people.imagined: The new furnace being lit. He rolls up his sleeve to renew the signing vow on his forearm, thumbing the scratched-out line. He is watching someone who skipped the vow, and he notes it.
people.subject: The moment: beside a new furnace he holds his right forearm up and out toward the viewer, sleeve pushed to the elbow, while his eyes slide to someone off frame. Face: most important, the tattooed forearm: the inside of the forearm carries six short black lines of small script-like strokes in a column, the fourth scratched through with a raw red scar, large in the frame (strokes only, no readable text). A narrow, pale, anxious face; deep-set, restless, grey eyes; thin brows pulled together; a long straight nose; thin compressed lips; a day's stubble. Hair: black, combed flat and tied in a topknot with a thin red-gold thread and a small silver pin. Body: wiry, tense, shoulders up. Clothing: perfectly pressed robes of pale grey silk in two crossed collars, a grey gauze over-robe with wide sleeves, a thin red-gold thread stitched round each cuff as a refiner's mark, a pale grey sash; the right sleeve pushed back and a smith's wrist-guard of grey silk cord removed from that arm. Hands and objects: the bare tattooed forearm; his left hand holds a long pair of iron tongs gripping a bar of dull red metal. Power: a hot red-orange shimmer of fire qi gathers round the bar and a grey-gold gleam of metal runs along his bare forearm. Background: a dim furnace hall with an arched mouth glowing orange, drifting smoke and black shadows. Light: strong orange furnace-glow from the right on the forearm, cool silver spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a narrow sidelong stare, the brows drawn tight and the lips pressed thin, a man watching someone who skipped the vow and counting it against them.

people.imagined: The auction floor in the instant before the hammer. She holds up her right hand, the forefinger bare, the other nine fingers heavy with rings, and decides the price by a glance. She wants the steward's floor.
people.subject: The moment: at the auction floor she raises her right hand beside her face, fingers spread, her gaze fixed on an object off frame. Face: most important, the rings: heavy rings of gold, jade and dark metal on every finger and thumb of the raised hand except the right forefinger, which is completely bare, large in the frame. A smooth, oval, poised face; high cheekbones; narrow, cool amber eyes under straight dark brows; a small straight nose; full lips with a faint appraising smile, painted a soft dark red, the lashes long. Hair: black, glossy, in a tight high coil held by a narrow red-gold thread and a pale jade pin. Body: slim, long-necked, upright. Clothing: perfectly pressed robes of pale grey silk in three crossed collars, a thin red-gold thread stitched along the collar edge as an appraiser's mark, a grey gauze over-robe with wide sleeves lined in softer grey, a long pale sash, no other colour. Hands and objects: the ringed hand raised; in the other a small wooden hammer with a red-gold head resting on a block. Power: a calm grey-gold ripple of metal qi with a warm earth-yellow thread rises round her raised hand and the rings. Background: a blurred, crowded auction floor, tall brass lamps in a long arc over rows of padded benches, the shapes of bidders only suggested in mist. Light: warm gold from lamps at the upper right, soft silver rim light on her hair and cheek. Expression: a poised, calm, appraising half-smile, the amber eyes cool and certain, a woman who decides the price with a glance.

people.imagined: The vault's weighing room. She is new, placed from Lạc Hà this spring, and she tilts a scale to weigh a chunk of ore while her brass weights chime at her belt. In her head is a list of what she will buy in 1230.
people.subject: The moment: in a weighing room she leans over a small scale with an ore chunk in the pan, eyes on the balance, her belt chiming. Face: most important, the brass weights: a string of small brass weights in graduated sizes hanging from her belt on a cord, clustered at the bottom of the frame, glinting. A plain, round, earnest, freckled face; short dark brows; level brown eyes; a flat nose; a closed, patient mouth. Hair: brown, in a single plain braid pinned up at the back with a small silver pin. Body: sturdy and short, her feet together and elbows against her ribs, small and neat in the narrow room. Clothing: the simplest graceful pale grey silk of an outer disciple: a pressed crossed-collar robe with no thread, wide sleeves tied back with grey cord, a long pale grey silk apron, a pale sash. Hands and objects: one hand adjusting a tiny weight on a brass pan scale; a lump of red-brown ore with a streak of pale metal in the pan; a small satchel at her hip. Power: a few earth-yellow motes of earth qi float over the scale. Background: a dim vault room with shelves of locked iron boxes, a thin silver mist at the floor. Light: soft cool spirit-light from the upper left, cold silver on the brass, dust drifting over the scale. Expression: a patient, level look at the balance, the lips closed and the brow smooth, a girl quietly adding up what she will buy.

people.imagined: The ash pit at noon. He grins and the front tooth flashes. His cousin lost his post through a rumour he spread, and he is still sifting for the lump he saw put back.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on an ash heap at noon he grins at the viewer, ash dusting his shoulders, a sorting sieve in his hands. Face: most important, the tooth: his upper left front tooth is bright gold-flecked, a flash of yellow metal in his grin, plainly visible. A lean, sharp, sun-dark face; quick, shrewd brown eyes; arched brows; a pointed nose; a crooked grin; fine grey ash in his eyelashes. Hair: black, cropped short and dusted grey with ash, a few short strands standing at the crown, bound with a thin red-gold thread. Body: lanky, loose-limbed, knees drawn up, back slumped, jaw jutting slightly. Clothing: the simplest graceful pale grey silk of an outer disciple: a crossed-collar robe with sleeves rolled to the elbow, no thread, a kerchief of grey gauze at the neck, ash on the knees, the left cuff singed brown at the edge, a pale sash. Hands and objects: a flat round sieve of wire in a wooden frame held in both hands, with three chunks of dull ore and one bright red-gold fleck in its middle. Power: a faint grey-gold sparkle of metal qi lifts from the red-gold fleck. Background: a grey slag heap, a black pit and a hazy yellow sky of drifting smoke. Light: harsh pale-gold noon spirit-light from the upper left, bleaching the ash on his hair almost white. Expression: a quick, sly, ambitious grin that flashes the gold-flecked tooth, a lad still sifting for the lump he saw put back.

people.imagined: A hot day on the auction floor. He copies the lot book with his collar buttoned to the chin, sweat on the lip but nothing out of place; he knows which names the steward leaves out.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk copying a book, in a hot room, he glances up at the viewer with his lips tightened. Face: most important, the buttoned collar: a stiff pale grey silk collar closed to the chin with a red-gold thread along its edge, even though beads of sweat stand on his lip and forehead. A narrow, proud, pale face with a long nose; light eyes half-lidded with disdain; thin brows; thin lips in a faint sneer. Hair: black, oiled and parted exactly, in a small tight knot with a pale jade pin. Body: slim, rigid, very upright, his back against the chair and elbows close, like a boy at an examination. Clothing: perfectly pressed robes of pale grey silk in two crossed collars closed to the throat, a red-gold thread along the collar edge as the appraiser's mark, narrow sleeves with ink-clean cuffs, a pale gauze over-robe, a jade toggle on the sash. Hands and objects: a fine brush with a black lacquered handle and a perfect point in his right hand; a bound blank book open before him and beside it a small porcelain water-dropper shaped like a duck. Power: a thin grey-gold line of metal qi follows the brush tip. Background: a bright shuttered office with a stack of boxes and a drift of warm haze. Light: hot yellow spirit-light from the upper left lying on the paper, a silver rim on his collar and the sweat on his lip. Expression: tightened lips and a proud, cool lift of the chin, the eyes quick and concealing, the face smooth and dry.

people.imagined: The cage house, a winter dusk. She rolls up her sleeves to feed, and every crescent bite-scar on both arms has a name. She sends ice to a bear that she can no longer feed.
people.subject: The moment: in a cage house she holds both bare forearms forward, palms up, sleeves pushed high, as she crouches to feed an unseen animal. Face: most important, the bite scars: dozens of pale crescent-shaped scars climb both forearms to the elbows, ranked in rows like little moons, clear and big in the frame. A weathered, strong, tanned face with a broad jaw; gentle, dark, patient eyes; thick straight brows; a short nose; a calm, soft mouth. Hair: black, in a thick braid wrapped around the head, bound with grey silk cord and a plain silver pin. Body: broad-shouldered and sturdy, crouched on the balls of her feet with her elbows on her knees, shoulders very wide. Clothing: the simplest graceful pale grey silk of an outer disciple: a clean crossed-collar jacket with wide sleeves pushed above the elbows, a pale silk apron with one leather gauntlet on a hand, a collar of soft grey fur, a pale sash; no thread. Hands and objects: a wooden bucket bound with iron bands on one knee, holding strips of dark raw meat; the other hand open and still; beyond the bars a pair of yellow eyes shines low in the dark. Power: soft earth-brown motes of earth qi drift round her open hand, calming the cage. Background: dim iron cage bars, the shapes of animals in the dark and a pale winter mist at the floor. Light: warm lantern gold from the right lighting each pale crescent scar, cool silver spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a soft, steady look with a brave set to the jaw, the eyes tender toward the animal and the mouth quiet.

people.imagined: A gentle morning in the mistress's room; a visitor arrives with something under a cloth. Her eyes go to what they carry before their face; one red-gold pin is all her decoration.
people.subject: The moment: standing very still and upright, she looks not at the viewer but at something just below the camera, eyes fixed on what they hold. Face: most important, the eyes and the pin: her gaze angled downward to the object, sharp and bright as a bird's, and a single small red-gold hairpin shining at the side of her head. A small, delicate, smooth face; thin straight brows; large, very dark, quick eyes; a small, straight nose; thin lips with the faintest curve; skin almost translucent with a fine blue vein at the temple. Hair: black, glossy, coiled in a tight high crown at the top of her head, fixed by that one red-gold pin and nothing else. Body: small, upright and slight, narrow shoulders squared. Clothing: the mistress's finest pale grey silk, flawless and plain: three crossed collars, a long over-robe of grey gauze with wide sleeves that fall like mist, a pale sash, no embroidery and no other ornament; her single red-gold pin is the only colour. Hands and objects: both hands clasped before her; at her wrist a small block of polished red gold on a cord, like a seal; slender fingers, nails cut short and clean. Power: a still, cool grey-gold radiance of metal qi surrounds her like moonlit frost, with a pale earth-yellow thread in it; the gold block glows faintly. Background: a bare, pale, quiet room with a single lacquer table, soft mist at the doorway. Light: soft cool moonlight from the upper left, a tiny glint on the pin, a silver rim on her shoulders. Expression: a keen, composed, acquisitive stillness, the dark eyes quick as a bird's and the lips with the faintest curve.

people.imagined: Furnace mouth, mid-refining. He lifts the cracked crucible lid like a shield and speaks as little as the hammer allows. Red-gold scales shine on his apron.
people.subject: The moment: facing the furnace mouth he holds up a large cracked round iron lid in front of his chest like a shield and looks over the top of it. Face: most important, the scalp and the lid: a bare, glazed, shiny, red-pink burn-scarred scalp without a hair, catching the furnace light, and a large cracked round iron crucible lid held in front. A broad, square, heavy face; small, deep-set, black eyes; no eyebrows to speak of; a wide flat nose; a thick, firm mouth; a heavy jaw; faint scorch marks across the cheekbones and the skin of the jaw stiff and shiny. Hair: none; bald. Body: huge, a barrel chest, shoulders like furnace bars. Clothing: the elder's richest robes of silver-grey brocade edged in red-gold, a collar and cuffs stitched in red-gold thread, a long pale gauze over-robe with the sleeves cut away to the shoulder, a breastplate of linked red-gold scales over the brocade, the thick forearms bare and burn-glazed, a heavy pale sash. Hands and objects: the cracked lid in his left hand, big and dull grey; a flying sword of red gold hanging point down in his right hand, gleaming. Power: a blazing hot red-orange and gold glow of fire and metal qi rolls round him, lifting sparks and the edges of his over-robe. Background: a roaring orange furnace mouth, black beams and a long iron rack of tongs and ladles on the dark wall, sparks hanging in the air. Light: strong orange furnace-glow from the right, silver-white spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a stolid, honest, silent patience, the small black eyes steady over the lid's edge, the mouth set.

people.imagined: The auction steward at the door of the floor, calling every guest by name. His silk coat is good but the cuffs are frayed because he has lost more at the table than he earns.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the doorway of a hall he spreads his hands in welcome, smiling broadly, calling a name. Face: most important, the unravelling cuffs and the smile: wide silk sleeves whose cuff edges visibly unravel into loose silk threads, held out in the foreground, and a broad, shining smile. A plump, round, smooth face; rosy cheeks; small bright black eyes with a flicker of unease; thin, neat brows; a button nose; a double chin; a thin moustache; a sheen of oil on nose and brow. Hair: black, slicked and thinning, in a small topknot with a jade pin and a red-gold thread. Body: plump, short, a round belly. Clothing: a good dove-grey silk robe in three crossed collars, a pale gauze over-robe, well cut, but its cuffs and hem are coming loose into threads (the one flaw he cannot hide, since he gambles away more than he earns); a red-gold thread at the cuffs; a jade belt-plaque; an over-large coin on a chain. Hands and objects: both hands spread wide, one with a large red-gold ring; a small book tucked in the sash. Power: a faint grey-gold sparkle of metal qi gathers about the ring. Background: the lit doorway of an auction hall, silk lanterns hanging in it, guests in fine dark robes waiting in soft focus, a haze of incense. Light: warm gold from the doorway, soft silver spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: an ingratiating, glossy, over-bright smile with a flicker of unease in the small eyes, a steward calling every guest by name and counting what he owes.

people.imagined: A northern road in snow. She has just returned from buying a white bear, and the fur collar is damp with snow. The scar through her eyebrow, from a bear's paw, whitens in the cold.
people.subject: The moment: standing in falling snow she turns her face toward the viewer and lets out a short unamused breath. Face: most important, the scar: a pale ridged scar runs straight through her left eyebrow from the forehead to the cheekbone, splitting the brow, white against her tan, big and plain. A lean, hard, travel-browned face; narrow, cold, grey-green eyes; straight dark brows; a long nose; thin lips set in a callous line; chapped cheeks; snowflakes melting on her lashes, the tip of her nose red. Hair: black with a few grey, in a long single tail tied with a thin red-gold thread, snow caught in it. Body: lean, strong, tall, standing wide. Clothing: a travelling robe of pale grey silk in two crossed collars under a long grey silk cloak with a wide collar of thick white northern fur, a thin red-gold thread at the cuff of the inner robe just showing, silk gloves, a pale sash with a bundle on one shoulder. Hands and objects: a coiled chain leash of dark iron in the right hand, wet with snow, its last links vanishing into the flurry where the huge pale shape of a white bear looms dim at its end; the left hand on a strap. Power: cold grey-gold sparks of metal qi run along the chain links and a few water-blue motes drift in the snow. Background: a snowy track, bare trees and a heavy cart dim in the flurry. Light: cold white-blue moonlight from the upper left, a silver rim on the fur. Expression: a hard, bored look with cold eyes and the corner of the mouth flat, a woman who has just bought a white bear and feels nothing about it.

people.imagined: The vault clerk on her day off, sifting the ash of Kim Cốc Thành. She coughs into her sleeve, hides it, and holds up a handful of ash in a gloved palm to the light.
people.subject: The moment: in a grey ash field she coughs into her sleeve, eyes watering, a hand of ash held out. Face: most important, the ash in the knuckles: fine grey ash worked deep into every crease and knuckle of her bare hand held out toward the viewer, dark lines of grey on the pale skin, large in the frame. A thin, pale, tired, careful face; hollow cheeks; light grey eyes red-rimmed; thin brows; a pinched nose; thin lips; her sleeve at her mouth; a thin streak of grey dust across the cheek. Hair: grey-streaked brown, pinned in a bun with a plain pale pin, a grey gauze scarf over it. Body: thin, narrow, slightly stooped, wrist bones fine. Clothing: robes of pale grey silk in two crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied back, a grey silk shawl, a red-gold thread at the cuff with a pale cough-stain of grey on it, a sifting apron of coarse cloth over the sash. Hands and objects: a wire sieve in the left hand; the right hand open and held out with ash. Power: faint earth-yellow motes of earth qi hang in the ash held to the light, with one grey-gold spark. Background: a flat grey plain of ash and burnt stone, a few charred timbers and a pale haze like drifting mist. Light: dull silver spirit-light from the upper left, flat and soft, one pale gleam on the ash in her palm. Expression: a patient, honest, wary tiredness, the red-rimmed eyes steady on the ash held to the light.

people.imagined: The furnace door. He has been told to forget the ring he saw in 1190. He holds a new hand's wrist near the heat to teach respect, and the lashless eyes stay perfectly dry.
people.subject: The moment: at the furnace door he holds out a hand gripping a young man's wrist (just the wrist and sleeve at the frame edge), his own face lit by the glow. Face: most important, the missing lashes: his eyelids are bare pink-red rims with no lashes at all, giving his wide black eyes a bare, staring look. A broad, flushed, heavy-jawed face; thick, short black brows; a short flat nose; a thin, cruel, patient smile; sweat shining on the forehead. Hair: black, cropped close. Body: thickset and strong, a short thick neck, leaning slightly forward like a bull at a gate. Clothing: a scorched robe of pale grey silk in two crossed collars with the sleeves rolled, a smith's apron of grey cloth over the sash, a thin red-gold thread stitched round each cuff as a refiner's mark, thick leather gloves tucked in the sash. Hands and objects: a heavy right hand holding another's wrist, the unseen wrist's sleeve a plain grey cuff with a thread at the edge; a long black iron poker with a hooked end glowing faintly orange at the tip in the left. Power: a strong hot orange-red shimmer of fire qi rolls off his shoulders and the poker, with grey-gold sparks in it. Background: an orange furnace door at his left, a black wall and drifting smoke. Light: strong orange furnace-glow from the left across his face on the bare lashless lids and the sweat, silver spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: a flat, impassive stare with dry lashless eyes, the thin smile unmoving, no pity in the face.

people.imagined: The auction floor. A seller has put up a lot, and she squints at it as at a doubtful coin. At eleven she called a forgery false to the seller's face; she would do it again.
people.subject: The moment: on the auction floor a tall girl squints hard at an object just in front of the viewer, chin out. Face: most important, the squint: her right eye narrowed nearly shut, her left eye wide open, the brows pulled to a sharp line, as if weighing a doubtful coin. A narrow face with a sharp, pointed chin; clear tan skin; very dark eyes; a straight, sharp nose; a thin, straight, righteous mouth. Hair: black, in a tall, tight, high ponytail bound with a red-gold thread and a pale jade pin. Body: tall, thin, upright, long neck stretched forward and chin out, shoulders back, like a heron. Clothing: crisp, perfectly pressed robes of pale grey silk in two crossed collars, a red-gold thread stitched along the collar edge as an appraiser's mark, narrow sleeves, a pale gauze over-robe lifting at the shoulder, a grey sash. Hands and objects: in her right hand a small round red-gold mirror the size of a palm, framed in a thin ring of red gold and polished bright, held up to her squinting eye, a thin dark line on its face showing a flaw as a thread; her left forefinger long and bony, pointing. Power: a bright thread of warm gold metal qi runs round the mirror's rim. Background: a blurred auction floor with tall brass lamps in soft mist. Light: warm lamp-gold from the upper right touching her squinting eye and the mirror's rim with a spark, silver rim light on the left. Expression: a hard, squinting stare with the chin thrust out, proud honest scorn at the mouth and a clear, fair-minded eye.

people.imagined: Slag pit at midday, a lazy afternoon. He weighs a heavy lump in one hand and puts it back; the walk to the office is long. Red-gold dust is on his cheekbones, and he will not wash it.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a slag heap at midday he holds a heavy dull lump in one hand, weighing it up and down, then drops it, shrugging. Face: most important, the dust: a glitter of fine red-gold dust scattered across his cheekbones and the bridge of his nose like freckles of metal, shining in the sun. A round, lazy, good-natured face; half-lidded brown eyes; short straight brows; a flat nose; a loose, slow smile. Hair: dark brown, thick and sticking up, dusted with ash, a thin red-gold thread bound round a small knot. Body: heavy-set, slouched, legs sprawled and big hands loose, belly rounded over the sash. Clothing: the simplest graceful pale grey silk of an outer disciple: a crossed-collar robe with sleeves rolled, dirty at the cuffs, a sorter's apron of grey cloth, a plain rope-tied sash, loose pale trousers. Hands and objects: a heavy dull lump of black glassy slag with a pocked skin and one bright orange vein in his right hand; his left on his knee; a half-empty water gourd at his hip. Power: a faint grey-gold glitter of metal qi rises from the orange vein. Background: a grey slag heap, a dark pit and a pale yellow sky in drifting haze. Light: bright pale-gold noon spirit-light from the upper left, making the dust on his cheeks twinkle like tiny gold sparks. Expression: a lazy, easy shrug of a face with heavy lids and a slack, trusting half-smile, content with the heap.

people.imagined: The studio yard, a new boy with a letter. A bruise on his shin from a different stumble each week; he stands carefully, with a patient face, three times failed by a hair.
people.subject: The moment: standing carefully in a yard he holds a sealed letter in both hands against his chest, then glances down at his shin. Face: most important, the shin and bruise: one trouser leg rolled to the knee and the shin carrying a fresh purple-blue bruise the size of a palm, with a yellow older one beside it, large in the frame at the bottom. A plain, narrow, earnest face; large, anxious, brown eyes; thin pale brows; a straight nose; a closed, patient mouth. Hair: brown, cropped, with a cowlick, tied with a thin grey ribbon. Body: lanky, careful, knees locked and thin shoulders squared, one leg a little forward to show the bruise. Clothing: the simplest graceful pale grey silk of an outer disciple: a clean crossed-collar jacket with no thread, a cloth sash, pale trousers one leg rolled, brown well-dust on the knees, straw sandals. Hands and objects: a letter folded in thirds with a plain red wax blob (no writing visible) held to the chest; a well-digger's small spade with a worn wooden handle and mud drying on its blade on his back. Power: a few earth-yellow motes of earth qi drift up from the dust round his feet. Background: a studio yard with grey walls, a well and a low pearl mist. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, even, showing both the fresh purple and old yellow bruises plainly. Expression: a careful, patient look with lowered eyes and a humble tilt of the head, the young face anxious yet steady.

people.imagined: The auction floor. She cries a price she was handed, true or not, and the silk scarf round her throat shakes. Her voice carries across the whole market.
people.subject: The moment: mid-cry, standing on a block, her mouth wide open, a hand cupped at her ear. Face: most important, the scarf and the open mouth: a thick pale gold-yellow silk scarf wound several times round her throat, and a wide-open mouth with visible tongue and teeth, calling. A broad, round, expressive face with bright cheeks; large, shining, hazel eyes; high arched brows; a short nose; strong lips. Hair: black, braided into two long plaits pinned up in a crown with a thin red-gold thread. Body: stout, strong chested, planted wide, her chest deep, ready to project. Clothing: the simplest graceful pale grey silk of an outer disciple: a crossed-collar robe with short wide sleeves, the pale gold silk scarf, a pale sash, a cloth apron; no thread. Hands and objects: one hand cupped at her ear, the other holding a small brass hand-bell no bigger than a fist, its wooden handle bound with red cord, at her side; beneath her a plain wooden box block. Power: a faint grey-gold shimmer of metal qi ripples outward from her open mouth like a sound-wave. Background: a blurred auction floor with a crowd and tall lamps in soft mist. Light: warm lamp-gold from the upper right catching the open mouth and the shimmer of the scarf, silver rim light on the left. Expression: a gregarious, bright, ringing face, the cheeks high and the eyes shining with a willingness to cry whatever price she is handed.

people.imagined: The brook at Khê Thanh, early. She washes the finest refinings, water running over her cold-red feet, and is calm. The refiner trusts her hands more than his own.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on a stone in a clear brook she holds out both hands, dripping, the water running off her wrinkled fingertips. Face: most important, the hands: both hands wrinkled white and puckered to the second knuckle from water, held up and dripping, and bare feet red from the cold in the water below. A calm, soft, round face; clear, still, dark eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a gentle closed mouth. Hair: black, in a simple long braid over one shoulder tied with a pale green ribbon. Body: sturdy, small, bent forward, knees together, her back curved. Clothing: a plain but clean and graceful blouse of pale grey-green silk with the wide sleeves tied up, a skirt of soft blue gauze tucked up, a wet pale apron; no ornament. She is a washer, a servant, so her dress is the plainest and cleanest. Hands and objects: the wrinkled dripping hands; beside her on a rock a shallow reed basket of washed red-gold grains glittering wet, bright orange-red and gleaming; each of her ten fingertips pale and puckered like a dried plum. Power: soft blue-green motes of water qi shimmer over her palms and the basket, drifting up with the mist. Background: a bright brook over pale stones, ferns and a morning mist. Light: bright clear spirit-light from the upper left, a net of moving water-light on the underside of her chin. Expression: a calm, quiet face with a soft, content half-smile and an honest, steady gaze lifted from the water.

people.imagined: 350, under the sign over the workshop door by the bay. A memorial portrait of the founder, a Xích Thổ smith who bought a mine before his lord heard of it, holding a small hammer and a lump of red gold.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a stout smith stands in his workshop door, holding a lump of red gold up to the light. Face: most important, the red-gold lump: a rough nugget of bright red-gold the size of a hen's egg, held up in a pair of tongs, the one bright colour in the picture. A broad, shrewd, ruddy face; narrow bright eyes; thick bristly black brows; a thick nose; a wide, sly, pleased mouth; a short beard; deep laugh lines from his nose to the corners of his mouth. Hair: black, tied back with a leather cord under a plain smith's cap of grey silk with a small silver pin. Body: thick, strong, squat, forearms thick and tanned dark, scarred by old sparks. Clothing: the founder's robes of pale silver-grey silk in two crossed collars with a thin red-gold border at collar and cuffs, a long gauze over-robe with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a leather smith's apron over it, a heavy belt of tools. Hands and objects: the nugget in tongs held aloft in the right hand; a small hammer in the left. Power: a gold shimmer of metal qi lifts off the nugget like a small flame, softened by the fade. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with the faint orange of a forge and a hint of mist. Light: soft warm spirit-light from the upper left, dark vignette. Expression: a shrewd, pleased smile, the bright eyes narrowed on the nugget in the tongs, the brows lifted.

people.imagined: 609, the auction floor. A memorial portrait of the second mistress who took a crier's girl off the floor, with a sutra scroll in one hand and a patient smile, a thin gold chain at the throat.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a composed woman stands holding a closed scroll with a faint smile. Face: most important, the closed scroll and the pale gold chain: a closed scroll bound with a red-gold cord held across her chest, and a thin gold chain with a small red-gold pearl at the throat. A calm, heavy-lidded, handsome face with strong cheekbones; patient dark eyes; straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, mild smile. Hair: black streaked with grey, coiled in a high flat knot with two gold pins. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, still, the scroll held across her at a measured angle. Clothing: the mistress's richest robes of silver-grey brocade in three crossed collars, edged and cuffed in red-gold thread, a long pale gauze over-robe with wide sleeves, a grey sash. Hands and objects: the scroll held in both hands, a hand-span thick, tied in a double knot of red-gold cord; a small pale ring on her right hand matching the pearl at her throat. Power: a soft warm gold glow of metal qi gathers round the scroll and the pearl, softened by the fade. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with a hint of a lamp and a hall in mist. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left, dark vignette; the yellowed silk deepens the shadows round her eyes and softens the cord's red-gold glow. Expression: a calm, heavy-lidded, patient look with the faint closed smile of a woman who counts every gain.
